## NPSphere 0.64.3

**Changed**
- **Clone, the GLPI way.** Surveys now use GLPI's own cloning, so it works like anything else in GLPI:
  - **Where:** tick a survey in the list and choose **Actions › Clone**, or use **Actions › Clone** inside a survey.
  - **What the copy gets:** the questions (conditional rules included) and the email templates.
  - **What it doesn't get:** the target audience, answers and sending history. It starts **inactive**.
  - The separate "Duplicate" button is gone.

**Mobile**
- **Emails** (invitation, reminder, report and alert) now fit on phones. The 0–10 score row used to be wider than the screen.
- **0–10 scores:** full-width buttons, 40 px tall, easy to tap.
- **Emoticons:** all five fit on one line.
- **Stars:** bigger.
- **Layout:** tighter margins on every answer page.
- **Send button:** full width.

**Install:** extract `npsphere-0.64.3.zip` into GLPI's `marketplace/` (or `plugins/`) folder, then go to **Setup › Plugins** and click **Update**.

Full history (in Portuguese): [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/MichaelRodriguesOficial/NPS-GLPi/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
